fact: On 1 November 2026 the national domain directorate launched a new version of the Fadaeldjazair geoportal on a unified central database holding over 27 million documents from 217 land conservations, where users request land books, deed copies and cadastral extracts online and pay stamp duty and cadastral fees online.
title: Fadaeldjazair : livret foncier, cadastre et actes, ce que change la nouvelle version du portail
